# Medical Tourism Business

> > A comprehensive platform providing CMTA certification, training courses, business tools, and consultancy services to help professionals launch and grow medical tourism agencies.

Medical Tourism Business (MTB) is a leading provider of industry certification, training programs, and business resources for medical tourism facilitators and startups. Founded by Gilliam Elliott Jr., the platform offers CMTA (Certified Medical Travel Agent) accreditation, membership programs, marketing strategies, and ready-to-use business templates to support entrepreneurs in building successful medical tourism businesses.

- CMTA Certification
- Medical Tourism Business

## Core Programs & Membership

- [Medical Tourism Business | Training Courses and Certification | Consultancy | Marketing](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com): MTB homepage: leading provider of medical tourism certification, training, consultancy, and marketing services.
- [Grow Your Medical Tourism Company | Membership Program | Medical Tourism Business](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/membership-programs): Comprehensive membership programs with CMTA certification, tools, mentorship, and templates.
- [Building A Medical Tourism Business Isn't Easy. We're Here To Help.](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/choose-your-membership-type): Membership options including Facilitator Gold and Elite tiers with proven business systems.
- [Step 1 of 2: Add Your Company To Directory & Membership Enrollment](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/add-your-company): Membership enrollment and company directory listing for medical tourism industry stakeholders.
- [About Medical Tourism Business | Facilitator Resources](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/about-us): MTB background, mission, and facilitator resources including growth kits and training.

## Certification & Accreditation Courses

- [Medical Tourism Accreditation & Training Courses](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/medical-tourism-accreditation-training-courses): Industry-recognized CMTA certification courses for medical tourism professionals.
- [Top Medical Tourism Certification for Beginners | MTB](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/top-medical-tourism-certification): Q&A guide on CMTA certification benefits, credibility, partnerships, and business growth.
- [Professional Medical Tourism Facilitator Certification and Memberships](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/should-i-get-a-medical-tourism-facilitator-certification): Guide to CMTA certification and all-inclusive memberships for medical tourism agencies.
- [Online Medical Tourism Certification Courses | Accreditation | Wellness Tourism](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/syllabus-medical-tourism-certification-course): Detailed syllabus outline for CMTA medical and wellness tourism certification course.
- [Medical Tourism Starter Course (Mini Course)](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/medical-tourism-starter-course-mini-course): Beginner-friendly mini course for launching medical tourism businesses and agencies.
- [Protect Your Business and Clients—Get Certified in Risk Management for Medical Tourism](https://medicaltourismbusiness.com/medical-travel-risk-management-and-compliance-certification): Compliance and risk management certification course for medical tourism facilitators.
